## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `73185026ac096e32255d544935a6a35d27106656`

### ① Derived judgments

Rendered in-seat by the skills seat 1 session at the served tier the maintainer named on this date (the fable tier word at `get_session` → `external_metadata.last_served_model`; ruling record 5771798588; the constant on `origin/main` names it since PR #19684). The contract is the card's measured refusal (a a WAS declaration declared inside a fenced block beside the act-clock token is refused `mixed` with a remedy prescribing that same declaration), the lane's grading 5753148560 (the three arms; 「the dev decides and pins」) and the seat's rider 5770506431 (the #18995 record's three follow-ups in the same file).

- **(a) The arm taken — accepted, with the argument pinned.** The dispatch's Zone 1 read the fix as 「the two readers take the same reading」; the dev took the card's third arm instead (the refusal stays, the remedy changes) and refused the other two in the file's header with the four axes: a a WAS declaration inside a quotation is rendered as TEXT by the quoting contract, so reading it as a declaration would give a quoted span a second semantic; exempting the fence from the bare scan is the one direction the MIXED / MASKING rows forbid; and neither arm serves the filed body, because a pasted `git log` line carries its stamp BARE and wrapping it would publish a quotation the command never emitted. The grading delegated the choice to the dev; the argument holds against the file's own header; the deviation from Zone 1 is declared, not silent. The dev's open question (A: what landed · B: teach the reader the fence) is graded **A** in-lane: B reverses the #18543 pins and is its own card if the maintainer wants it — ⛔ not a decision-box item.
- **(b) The rider — three of four clauses delivered and pinned, one measured not reproducing.** (c) the body-wide `quotedValueProblems === 0` gate is now per value (`refusedValues`, the payload and every stamp inside it; case 「a typo elsewhere no longer hides the row at a position」) and `positionsTaken` is a multiset (`takeCredit`; case 「two subscript lines carrying the SAME declared stamp are TWO rows」, bare control unchanged); (f) `hit.stamp === now` is now minute containment through `stampSpan` (`readingIsThisMinute`; the seconds-grain own-clock case accepted, the minute BEFORE still refused, ⛔ never `H56_STAMP_TOLERANCE_MIN`); (e) first clause is the card's defect; the second clause's chain was measured on the base as `[mixed, mixed] → [positional] → accepted`, not `positional → positional-declared` — reported, not papered over; accepted as measured.
- **(c) Diff and hygiene — right.** One file, +188 / −54, three commits (two steps + the `origin/main` merge at `4fba5036f`, the merge base), blob `0b582cc79` at the head; `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` floors 52 → 60 and 17 → 24, never lowered; the header gains a dated section; trailers model-free per `check:commit-card-trailers` (the harness reminder yields to the repo file, os-dev.md). Net +134 against Zone 3's optional ≤ +80 — +35 header, +29 cases, the rest two readers with doc comments; declared, accepted. The 维护者速读 on a non-governed PR is harmless.
- **(d) ⛔ THE FINDING — the remedy names a route that does not post, measured by this seat on the head, not the report.** The seat imported `stampRefusals` from the base (`4fba5036f`) and from the head and ran six body shapes (`scratchpad/seat/probe-19707.mjs`). The filed repro (the act-clock token + a a WAS declaration inside a fence) is refused `mixed` on both, and the head's remedy now ends 「The route that works is the same declaration OUTSIDE the quotation — a WAS declaration in the prose beside it」. An author who follows it — declares the reading in the prose and leaves the fenced line as pasted, with the token or with bare digits — is refused `mixed` again on the head, and that second refusal carries the OLD circular text 「Declare it with a WAS declaration if it is a quoted reading」 while that declaration already stands in the prose: `quotedSpanRemedy` returns null there (one occurrence, the prose declaration, is outside the span) and the ordinary remedy fires. The only shape that posts is the one whose fence carries NO digits (the self-test's 「the body that takes that route POSTS」 case is exactly that, and so was the card's own successful post) — and no remedy on the head says so. The base's dropped clause did (「Move the stamp out of the quotation to declare it」). The circle the card measured is not closed; it moved one step, which is the rider's (e) shape: a refusal prescribing what is already on the page.
- **(e) Gates — measured by this seat on a clean worktree at `73185026a` after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`.** `check:pm-post-stamped` 577 cases / 19 batteries, `check-half-states.mjs --self-test` 5160, `close-cards.mjs --self-test` 102, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-self-test-wired`, `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` — all exit 0; eslint over the file 1 judged, 0 / 0; no raw control byte; `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 19707` exit 0 — NOT governed, 0 of 1 path on the register, 242 lines. The dev's 30-family derivation reconciled `--ran` 30 / 30 / 0 NOT-MEASURED, the 11-minute `check:pm-dispatch-gates` run twice (pre-merge and merged head), and the ablation (the mixed route selection nulled ⇒ 6 of 577 red, blob restored `0b582cc79`) read as reported. CI at this head: 31 latest-per-name check runs, `Lint & Repo Gates` in progress at the seat's read, the rest success or skipped.

### ② Semver level

None — no release. `scripts/pm/**` is in no package's `files[]`; `skip-changeset` is the correct carrier, written through `label-write.mjs` with read-back; `size/m` is the labeler's.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Not governed** — ordinary queue landing by the seat on a PASS record, `--pair` 0 and all checks green; ⛔ not before the patch round below.
- **Report** 5774603526 on the card parses (`os-dev-report` first line; the JSON re-parses from the stored comment); `mcp_calls` 0; three REST writes plus four pushes as budgeted; ⛔ no body PATCH by the dev.
- **Out of scope, noted by the dev, not filed**: the `positional-declared` wording 「renders THERE as the bare stamp」 for a verbatim opener at a position (a nit); `h56StampedReadings` returning no line index (a shape observation in `check-half-states.mjs`).

**Must change before this record can read PASS** (one round, this file only): (1) the quoted-span remedy tail says the DIGITS leave the quotation — the reading is declared in the prose beside it and the quoted line is pasted WITHOUT its stamp (or quotes the placeholder form); a quotation that keeps the digits is still a bare stamp there; (2) the shape 「the value declared in the prose AND the same digits standing inside a quotation, bare or token-wrapped」 gets a remedy that names the quoted occurrence and says to take the digits out — ⛔ never 「Declare it with a WAS declaration」, which is already on the page; (3) both pinned: the chain that FOLLOWS each remedy from the filed repro ends ACCEPTED, every step's text naming the next step, plus the prose-declared-and-quoted shape's remedy; floors up. Everything else in the diff stands.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-19319-post-stamped-fenced-declared-stamp`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Wnstp2kTth7sGXfr8fXypc`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

The dev's ablation on the new route (`proseDeclared += 1` → `return null` ⇒ 5 of 584 red — the step-2 pins — STEP 3 and every control green; blob restored `226f7a6cd114`) reads as reported. The dev's lesson is recorded in the file: the first cut's 「POSTS」 case proved a body posts, never that FOLLOWING the remedy reaches it.
- **(e) Gates — measured by this seat on a clean worktree at `e976b048e`.** `check:pm-post-stamped` 584 / 19, `check-half-states.mjs --self-test` 5160, `close-cards.mjs --self-test` 102, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-self-test-wired`, `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` — all exit 0; eslint over the file 1 judged, 0 / 0; no raw control byte; `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 19707` exit 0 — NOT governed, 0 of 1 path, 317 lines.
